paper: Applying Linked Data Principles in Digital Water: A Modular Framework for Semantic Integration and FAIR-oriented Data Sharing
adaptation: Python scripts copied from the paper workspace. Paths, dependency loading and installation/source metadata lookup adapted to this standalone repository. Database paths use environment variables. Benchmark transformations, queries and timing boundaries retained. Cross-parameter audit writes under results/. verify_data.py added to verify and extract the packaged data.

transformation_pipeline.status: Standalone reproducibility adapter added after the measured experiment; not the original timed benchmark runner.
transformation_pipeline.reuses: Canonicalisation and snippet encoding from prepare_data.py; SHACL shapes and explicit sensor classifications from the paper worked example.
transformation_pipeline.mapping: data/pipeline_resources/dessel.rml.ttl implements the revised five-field profile. The original Dessel mapping is preserved separately as original_dessel_mapping.rml.ttl; it emits sensor/property literals and is not interchangeable with the revised profile.
transformation_pipeline.scope: Historical Dessel export. Units remain metres and cubic metres per second; no conductivity conversion, live acquisition, deployed publisher or synchronisation is claimed.

verification.scope: Small end-to-end demonstrations; full-dataset transformation pipeline not rerun
